title: George Bemis Professor of International Law
bio: Jonathan Zittrain is the George Bemis Professor of International Law at Harvard Law School. He is also a Professor of Public Policy, Harvard John F. Kennedy School of Government, a professor of computer science at the Harvard School of Engineering and Applied Sciences, faculty director of the Harvard Law School Library, and co-founder and director […]
